References.Title: Asset usage and references
References.Active: Assets used by the active effect
References.ChooseFolder: Folder to index recursively (this window only)
References.PartialErrors: Some sources could not be indexed (diagnostics)
References.Coverage: Partial scope: open documents (current states), active Group library and {0} registered folders (manual refresh). Other folders, inaccessible/unreadable content, history states, opaque custom data and engine-internal dependencies are excluded. Zero results never prove an asset is unused. Local files are location keys, not portable asset IDs.
References.EngineCoverage: Unreal editor connections: {0}. Legacy references have no project binding attestation; a connection does not prove that the asset exists in that project.
References.Truncated: Index limits reached. Results are incomplete.
References.NoMatches: No references matched in this view and indexed scope. This is not a global unused-assets result.
References.IndexKey: Location/legacy index key (NOT a portable asset ID): {0}
References.OutgoingScope: Outgoing references include saved instance contents and the registered current Group source, which can have different revisions; locations identify their source. Engine dependencies and material slots without saved metadata are unknown. Matching legacy text in another source is only an inferred candidate.
References.Disconnected: No Unreal asset connection; legacy binding unverified
References.GroupMissing: Source absent from active library; saved graph retained
References.UnreadableProject: Document not read; outgoing references unknown
References.FolderLimit: Register at most 16 folders in this window.
References.GoTo: Go to use / preview library source
References.RefreshRequired: Folder registered. Refresh to read it. Registration lasts until this window closes or the project changes.
References.Refreshed: Reference snapshot refreshed. Unregistered and inaccessible files remain outside coverage.
References.SourceUnavailable: Source is unavailable. Refresh the index.
